currentWork.title: FINAL.44 production complete; task-threshold gauge field confirmation pending
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.44 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. Task-tab progress gauges now scale against each task's configured auto-completion threshold while actual progress text and completion logic remain unchanged.
releaseScope: A task configured to auto-complete at N% now treats N% actual completion as a full gauge.
Example: a 70% threshold displays 35% actual progress as half the gauge and 50% actual progress as about 71.4% of the gauge.
The task detail progress gauge uses the same threshold-relative scale.
Displayed actual percentage, target counts, task completion threshold, and auto-completion logic are unchanged.
No routing, HGV, task-target, persistence, order, or arrival behavior changed.
